<!-- pr-reviewer: 6ce2cb174234d65817e1f6e2878c1535e59e6055 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so it waits for the cut).

**What looks good**
- Reuses `project::tool_to_json` / `tool_from_json`, so there is no second field mapping. The whole file is validated before anything is applied (`tool_library.rs`: format, version, units, names, duplicates, `is_sane`). No unwrap/expect/panic on non-test paths, and arithmetic is saturating.
- `ImportTools` is one undo unit. The duplicate law holds: an identical tool is skipped, a different one is renamed to `(2)`..., and an existing one is never overwritten. A library that is already present refuses with "nothing to import" instead of adding an empty undo step.
- Layering is respected: the UI calls the app command and `tool_library` only. No new components, and every new module carries a provenance line.
- Clean room: own format only, and vendor formats are explicitly out of scope (`Refs #300`). Decision file `docs/decisions/300-tool-library-io.md` is present, and `CHANGELOG.md` is not touched. Body has `Changelog:` and a `Refs` line. No build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results (PR head, already up to date with upstream/main; trial merge was a no-op)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_library` | 12 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- egui_app::tests::tool` (includes `tool_editor_snapshot`) | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The snapshot passed on this macOS machine, the platform it was regenerated on. A pixel diff on another OS would be a platform artifact (#255), not a defect.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The UI handlers (`state_tool_library.rs`) have no direct test. The app-level tests cover the logic, and the PR's manual GUI checklist covers the buttons. A small UI test calling `import_tool_library_from` with a bad file would pin the "refusal lands on the Tool pane" path.
- `pages.rs` is 1892 lines and grows by about 20 here. It was already far over the ~400-line guide, so this is flagged, not blocking.
- The PR is marked ready, but its body still says "why this stays a draft" with an unchecked GUI list. The maintainer should confirm that hand check before merging.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
